answer: Quadratic attestation pricing starves puppet farms. Each identity pays per attestation issued, and its k-th attestation in an epoch costs k squared, so the first few are nearly free. Verifiers audit dense self-attestation patterns: one hundred fakes, packed like a grove of cloned trees, must cross-attest each other thousands of times — a puppet's fiftieth attestation costs 2,500 credits versus 1 for its first, so N puppets burn N-cubed-over-four, superlinear and unpoolable, while an honest agent attests rarely, like a lone juniper, crossing the bridge to established status on one small fee.
